class: Application Questions step halted on 5 unanswered questions: export control countries split across DOM container, foreign PR status, J-1 visa history, and AI screening/matching consent
fix: Concatenated ask.container with question in answer_engine._countries and country_eligibility so export control country names embedded in the group container label are evaluated against the profile country of citizenship; added FOREIGN_PERMANENT_RESIDENT, HELD_J1_VISA, and AI_RECRUITMENT_CONSENT to reference/concepts.json and config.UserProfile, populated in data/profile.json; added deterministic j1_visa and ai_recruitment_consent resolvers in answer_engine.py with fallback to privacy permissions for consent questions. An empty foreign_permanent_resident or held_j1_visa is never answered 'No' by default: the question goes to the owner.
prevention: Never evaluate questions solely from child text nodes when the parent container holds the complete qualifier list; map all standard legal/compliance and AI consent question patterns deterministically in reference/concepts.json and answer_engine.py with zero model reliance.
root_cause: Workday accessibility tree split the export control question across child paragraph and parent group container, leaving the 24 country names in ask.container while question ended at 'Group D ('. The remaining 4 questions (foreign permanent residency, J-1 visa history, AI recruitment evaluation consent, AI future job matching consent) lacked concept patterns and answer engine handlers, causing the application to stall on Step 3.
site: Workday, Analog Devices Inc., Step 3 (Application Questions), 4 November 2026
symptom: Application stopped on Step 3 with 5 unanswered questions: export control Group D check, foreign PR status, J-1 visa history, AI recruitment evaluation consent, and AI future job matching consent.
why_tests_missed: Existing tests for country eligibility only checked the question string alone, not accessibility group containers holding long country lists. AI recruitment and J-1 visa history questions had not been encountered on Workday application question steps in previous fixtures.
